INSERT INTO problem_list (id, name, description, color, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES
(#{l.id}, #{l.name}, #{l.description}, #{l.color}, #{l.sortOrder}, #{l.createdAt}, #{l.updatedAt}, #{l.deleted})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), color = VALUES(color), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), deleted = VALUES(deleted)
